title: culcita straminea
intro: Culcita straminea, commonly known as the golden back fern, is a species of fern in the family Blechnaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a demulcent, providing a protective barrier to wounded tissues, and its use as a vulnerary, promoting wound healing and tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of the golden back fern include triterpenoid saponins, phenolic compounds, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
